important_instructions: Applications must reach the office of the Chief Medical Officer, Ghaziabad, by 17 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM via registered post, speed post, or in person. Walk-in interviews will be conducted on 29 October 2026 starting at 10:00 AM at the CMO Ghaziabad seminar hall. No TA/DA (travel allowance) will be paid for attending the interview. Appointments are purely contractual under the National Health Mission and will remain valid up to 31 March 2027, subject to extension based on approval from the Government of India. Candidates have no claim to regularisation or permanent absorption. The number of vacancies is subject to change at any stage of the recruitment process. Services can be terminated by giving 1 month notice or 1 month salary in lieu thereof, in case of any adverse findings during the selection process or service.
